title: 第25章 天渊山脉第26章 雷猿
lines: 麻脸青年说道：“我比你年长一些，我也就不欺负你了，你我对拼一拳，只要你能接下，便算你过关，最后一个名额就是你的。”
“好，一言为定！”
许辰一口答应。
“小心了。”
麻脸青年见许辰一口答应，提醒了一句，然后身形猛地一冲，几个跨步来到许辰面前，比普通人大了一圈的拳头，如磨盘般砸来，破风声低沉。
望着迎面而来的一拳，许辰不躲不闪，右手紧握成拳，迎击而上。
仿佛巨石碰撞的声音响起，麻脸青年面色一变，趔趄着向后退了一步，许辰却是纹丝不动的站在原地。
四周众人见到这一幕，齐齐大声叫好。
麻脸青年面色一阵青一阵白。
许辰对着麻脸青年拱了拱手，道：“多谢大哥手下留情，否则落入下风的就是小弟。”
麻脸青年闻言，脸上神色稍缓。
是啊。
他刚才没用全力。
否则，落入下风的一定是对方。
麻脸青年说道：“我虽然未尽全力，但你小子是真有本事，我做主了，最后一个名额归你了。”
“多谢大哥。”
许辰故作欣喜道。
“小兄弟，恭喜你的加入。”
刀疤男子走了过来，主动说道“我叫洪毅，追风小队队长。”
许辰对着洪毅拱了拱手，道：“许辰。”
“我叫徐虎！”
麻脸青年徐虎先是自我介绍，然后向许辰介绍小队的其他人。
手持大刀的王硕，面色黝黑的杨建，身材壮硕的李忠，这三人，以及洪毅，徐虎，都是追风小队成员。
最后一人，名叫赵枫，凝气境三重巅峰修为，和许辰一样，都是追风小队临时招募的队员。
人员凑齐，七人小队立刻出发，向八十里外的天渊山脉赶去。
一行七人跨越八十里距离，到了天渊山脉。
“许辰，天渊山脉无边无际，妖兽数不胜数，我们只是凝气境，只能在山脉外围活动，不能深入，当然机遇往往与危险并存……”
徐虎凑到许辰身边，小声说道。
许辰一边走，一边仔细聆听。
content_en:
The pockmarked young man said: "I'm older than you, so I won't bully you anymore. You and I will fight each other. As long as you can take it, you will pass, and the last spot will be yours."
"Okay, it's a deal!"
Xu Chen agreed immediately.
"Be careful."
Seeing Xu Chen's immediate agreement, the pock-marked young man reminded him, and then he suddenly rushed forward and came to Xu Chen in a few steps. His fist, which was a circle larger than an ordinary person, hit him like a millstone, with a low sound of breaking the wind.
Looking at the oncoming punch, Xu Chen did not dodge, clenched his right hand into a fist, and faced the punch.
"Bang!"
As if the sound of the collision of boulders was heard, the pockmarked young man's expression changed and he staggered back a step, but Xu Chen stood motionless.
"Okay."
When everyone around saw this scene, they all cheered loudly.
The pockmarked young man's complexion turned blue and white.
Xu Chen cupped his hands towards the pockmarked young man and said, "Thank you, big brother, for being merciful. Otherwise, it would be my little brother who would be at a disadvantage."
When the pockmarked young man heard this, his expression softened slightly.
yes.
He didn't use all his strength just now.
Otherwise, the opponent will definitely be at a disadvantage.
The pockmarked young man said: "Although I didn't try my best, you are really capable. I made the decision, and the last spot is yours."
"Thank you, brother."
Xu Chen pretended to be happy.
"Little brother, congratulations on joining."
The scarred man came over and said proactively, "My name is Hong Yi, captain of the Wind Chasing Team."
Xu Chen cupped his hands towards Hong Yi and said, "Xu Chen."
"My name is Xu Hu!"
Xu Hu, a pockmarked young man, first introduced himself and then introduced the rest of the team to Xu Chen.
Wang Shuo holding a big sword, Yang Jian with a dark complexion, and Li Zhong with a strong build. These three people, as well as Hong Yi and Xu Hu, are all members of the chasing team.
The last person, named Zhao Feng, has a peak level of cultivation at the third level of Qi Condensation Realm. Like Xu Chen, he is a temporarily recruited member of the Wind Chasing Team.
After gathering the personnel, the seven-man team set off immediately and rushed towards the Tianyuan Mountains eighty miles away.
…
A group of seven people crossed a distance of eighty miles and arrived at the Tianyuan Mountains.
"Xu Chen, the Tianyuan Mountains are boundless and there are countless monsters and beasts. We are only in the Qi Condensation Realm and can only move around the periphery of the mountains and cannot go deep. Of course, opportunities often coexist with dangers..."
Xu Hu came close to Xu Chen and whispered.
Xu Chen listened carefully as he walked.
